svg.title: Locksmith — Non-binary person
svg.desc: A fictional non-binary person working as locksmith, wearing a work jacket. Visible work cue: A profiled lock cylinder with keyway is paired with a separate service key and a fine bent lock pick below. The person is on the left, with the work cue on the right. Appearance: a bob haircut, a rounded face.
